tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to be or act as prince, rule, contend, have power, prevail over, reign, govern
1a) (Qal) to rule over, govern
1b) (Hithpael) to lord it over
Also means: sur (שׂוּר "to reign" H7786)
